Hi all —

Quick legal read of v3 and comments for procurement (high level):

1) Invoice remit and tax evidence
- We need the invoice remit entity confirmed before signature. If Streampoint prefers the UK entity for invoicing, commercial should reflect currency and tax treatment (GBP vs USD) explicitly in Appendix A.
- If Streampoint will withhold VAT/withholding tax locally, we need to include an indemnity clause or gross-up language. Prefer: explicit line in Order Form that states Redwood will invoice gross and tax responsibility handled post-invoice via credit/true-up. (If Streampoint cannot accept gross billing, we will escalate to Finance for a modified netting approach.)

2) Minimum commit line items
- Request: add a separate invoice line showing the Minimum Commit as an annually-billed line item with clear start/end dates. This avoids ambiguity in revenue recognition and makes it easier for AP to accept PO/matching.

3) Net terms
- Standard Redwood position is Net 45 for reserved capacity. If Streampoint requires Net 30, we need approval from Revenue Ops for deal economics. Ben — can you confirm margin impact if Net 30 is granted?

4) PO acceptance and reference
- Redwood accepts PO numbers on invoices. Confirm whether Streampoint will supply a single PO for the committed amount or multiple POs per invoice period.

5) Next steps / timeline
- Kimberly: will produce a short redline of the Order Form (tracked changes) and share with Naomi by EOD tomorrow.
- Naomi/Ben: please confirm whether the Minimum Commit should be annual prepay, invoiced monthly, or Net with milestone invoices.

Cc: Daniel & AP — we will send an updated OrderForm_v4 with the requested invoice line and gross-up language for review.

Thanks,
